name: Ring Fallout
steps: Set gymnastic rings low near the ground, grip them firmly, and step back into a straight-arm forward-leaning plank.
Squeeze your glutes, brace your abs, and lock your arms straight with shoulders packed.
Lean smoothly forward as your straight arms glide overhead in front of you until your body extends near horizontal.
Pull down strongly through your abs and lats to draw the rings back underneath your shoulders.
tips: Tuck your pelvis slightly under and stop extending as soon as you feel your lower back starting to arch.
Adjust strap height or foot stance to scale resistance smoothly while maintaining strict trunk control.
